        /// <summary>Converts a value read via GetValue to the property's type. See AUD-R25.</summary>
        private static T ReadFallback<T>(object value)
        {
            if (value is T typed)
                return typed;

            global::System.Type target = typeof(T);

            if (target.IsEnum)
            {
                return value is string enumText
                    ? (T)global::System.Enum.Parse(target, enumText, true)
                    : (T)global::System.Enum.ToObject(target, global::System.Convert.ChangeType(value, global::System.Enum.GetUnderlyingType(target), global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }

            if (target == typeof(char) && value is string charText)
                return (T)(object)(charText.Length > 0 ? charText[0] : '\0');

        #if NET6_0_OR_GREATER
            if (target == typeof(global::System.DateOnly))
            {
                return (T)(object)(value is string dateText
                    ? global::System.DateOnly.Parse(dateText, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    : global::System.DateOnly.FromDateTime(global::System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
            }

            if (target == typeof(global::System.TimeOnly))
            {
                if (value is string timeText)
                    return (T)(object)global::System.TimeOnly.Parse(timeText, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (value is global::System.TimeSpan timeSpan)
                    return (T)(object)global::System.TimeOnly.FromTimeSpan(timeSpan);
                return (T)(object)global::System.TimeOnly.FromDateTime(global::System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
        #endif

            // Convert.ChangeType cannot reach these - none of them is IConvertible-convertible
            // from string - and a provider on the IDataReader path may well hand back text.
            if (value is string text)
            {
                if (target == typeof(global::System.TimeSpan))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.TimeSpan.Parse(text, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(global::System.DateTimeOffset))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.DateTimeOffset.Parse(text, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(global::System.Guid))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.Guid.Parse(text);
            }

            if (target == typeof(global::System.DateTimeOffset) && value is global::System.DateTime dateTime)
                return (T)(object)new global::System.DateTimeOffset(dateTime);

            if (target == typeof(global::System.Guid) && value is byte[])
                throw new global::System.InvalidCastException(
                    $"Cannot convert a value of type '{value.GetType().FullName}' to '{target.FullName}'. " +
                    "If the provider returns this column as a byte array, map the property as byte[] and " +
                    "convert it yourself - the byte order of a binary GUID is provider-specific and Extrode.Jaunty " +
                    "will not guess it.");

            return (T)global::System.Convert.ChangeType(value, target, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        {
            private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<IDataReader, CacheEntry> _cache = new();
#if !NET8_0_OR_GREATER
            private static readonly object _cacheWriteLock = new();
#endif
            [ThreadStatic]
            private static WeakReference<CacheEntry>? _last;

            public static CacheEntry Resolve(IDataReader reader)
            {
                var names = __jauntyNames.Current.Names;
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is not null && lastRef.TryGetTarget(out var last) && last.Matches(reader, names))
                    return last;

                if (_cache.TryGetValue(reader, out var cached) && cached.Matches(reader, names))
                {
                    SetLast(cached);
                    return cached;
                }

                var ords = new int[5];
                ords[0] = reader.GetOrdinal(names.Column(0));
                ords[1] = reader.GetOrdinal(names.Column(1));
                ords[2] = reader.GetOrdinal(names.Column(2));
                ords[3] = reader.GetOrdinal(names.Column(3));
                ords[4] = reader.GetOrdinal(names.Column(4));
                var entry = new CacheEntry(reader, ords);
#if NET8_0_OR_GREATER
                _cache.AddOrUpdate(reader, entry);
#else
                lock (_cacheWriteLock)
                {
                    _cache.Remove(reader);
                    _cache.Add(reader, entry);
                }
#endif
                SetLast(entry);
                return entry;
            }

            private static void SetLast(CacheEntry entry)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is null)
                    _last = new WeakReference<CacheEntry>(entry);
                else
                    lastRef.SetTarget(entry);
            }

            public sealed class CacheEntry
            {
                private readonly IDataReader _reader;
                private readonly int _fieldCount;

                public CacheEntry(IDataReader reader, int[] ordinals)
                {
                    _reader = reader;
                    _fieldCount = reader.FieldCount;
                    Ordinals = ordinals;
                }

                public int[] Ordinals { get; }

                public bool Matches(IDataReader reader, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedNames names)
                {
                    if (!ReferenceEquals(reader, _reader))
                        return false;

                    if (reader.FieldCount != _fieldCount)
                        return false;

                    var ord0 = Ordinals[0];
                    if ((uint)ord0 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord0), names.Column(0), global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord1 = Ordinals[1];
                    if ((uint)ord1 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord1), names.Column(1), global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord2 = Ordinals[2];
                    if ((uint)ord2 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord2), names.Column(2), global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord3 = Ordinals[3];
                    if ((uint)ord3 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord3), names.Column(3), global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord4 = Ordinals[4];
                    if ((uint)ord4 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord4), names.Column(4), global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    return true;
                }
            }
